parts.text: Hello! What can you help me do as a reading companion?

Introduces BookCompanion as an interactive summarized-book reading companion that turns uploaded PDF books, articles, and papers into chapter-by-chapter narrative digests with page citations, deep-dive phrase search, and grounded check-in quizzes, and invites the reader to upload or share a PDF.
Please load tests/eval/fixtures/distributed_systems_field_guide.pdf and give me the abridged chapter summary for ch01.

Loads Distributed Systems Field Guide and presents an engaging narrative digest of Chapter 1 (Foundations of Distributed Consensus) covering state machine replication, safety vs. liveness, and the FLP impossibility theorem, grounded with [p. 1] citations and a reading navigation prompt.
Please load tests/eval/fixtures/distributed_systems_field_guide.pdf and give me a check-in quiz for ch02.

Loads Distributed Systems Field Guide and presents a 2-question check-in quiz for Chapter 2 (Leader Election and Quorum Leases) covering Raft subproblems, randomized election timeouts, majority quorums, or heartbeats, without revealing the answer key or spoilers before the reader answers.
